say:1:1029124001:1.text: What's Mr. Valen doing here...? Oh no! Run, everyone!
say:1:1029124001:1.source_cn: 维伦先生怎么会在这里……糟糕，大家快逃！

say:2:1029124002:1.text: ... What do you all want? We Shadow Chasers never bow to authority!
say:2:1029124002:1.source_cn: 你们想做什么？先说好，吾等追影者可是不会屈服于权威的…...

say:4:1029124003:1.text: T-That's right! If you want to be tough, I, Varrus, will never go down without a fight!
say:4:1029124003:1.source_cn: 没、没错！你们要是想来硬的，我华菲斯也绝对不会束手就擒！

say:5:1029124004:1.text: Please, kids, calm down. Considering your age, I'm not gonna be violent. I do, however, have to remind you all—
say:5:1029124004:1.source_cn: 各位小朋友们，放轻松。以你们的年纪，我当然是不会对各位...

say:6:1029124005:1.text: The Shadow Chasers is an illegal organization. As a member of the Heroic Order, I hereby declare its dissolution. Should anyone object...
say:6:1029124005:1.source_cn: “追影者”组织“非法运营”。所以，我现在以骑士团的身份...

say:7:1029124006:1.text: Then I shall round you all up and notify your parents to come collect you from General Hogan!
say:7:1029124006:1.source_cn: 那我就把你们统统带走，然后通知父母去霍根将军那里领人！

say:8:1029124007:1.text: O-Our parents? I'm done for! My mother and father will tear me to pieces...
say:8:1029124007:1.source_cn: 通、通知父母认真的？完了，我会被爸妈撕成碎片的……

say:9:1029124008:1.text:
My parents are scarier than Hypogeans!
 Please, Mr. Valen! Let us go!
say:9:1029124008:1.source_cn: 我爸妈简直比恶魔还可怕！\n 拜托了，维伦先生！请放过...

choice_prompt:10:1029124008.text:
My parents are scarier than Hypogeans!
 Please, Mr. Valen! Let us go!
choice_prompt:10:1029124008.source_cn: 我爸妈简直比恶魔还可怕！\n 拜托了，维伦先生！请放过吾——放过我们！

say:11:1029124009:1.text: I-I can't just tell anyone about that! It's classified.
say:11:1029124009:1.source_cn: 唔……这、这可不是随随便便就能说的事情！这涉及到我们的...

say:12:1029124010:1.text: Come on, what could possibly be classified as a made-up group run by a few kids?
say:12:1029124010:1.source_cn: 得了吧，几个半大孩子搞的过家家组织，能有什么机密？

say:13:1029124011:1.text: Hurry up and answer <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s question. Maybe I'll be more merciful when I'm in a better mood.
say:13:1029124011:1.male: Hurry up and answer <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s question. Maybe I'll be more merciful when I'm in a better mood.
say:13:1029124011:1.female: Hurry up and answer <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s question. Maybe I'll be more merciful when I'm in a better mood.

say:14:1029124012:1.text: Why don't we just tell them, Boss? Think of your parents! It's not too late... otherwise we're all done for!
say:14:1029124012:1.source_cn: 老大，要不我们还是赶紧招了吧？想想你爸妈！趁现在还来得...

say:15:1029124013:1.text: Fine... As it happens, the ultimate goal of the Shadow Chasers is to defeat Hypogeans.
say:15:1029124013:1.source_cn: 好吧……其实我们追影者的最终目的，就是战胜恶魔。

say:16:1029124014:1.text: Oh? That's... not quite what I was expecting.
say:16:1029124014:1.source_cn: 哦？这倒还真是……意料之外的答案。

say:17:1029124015:1.text: Surprised? We made this group not to just worship Hypogeans, but to first summon them—
say:17:1029124015:1.source_cn: 哼哼，想不到吧？我们建立这个组织，并不是单纯地崇拜恶魔...

say:18:1029124016:1.text: And then give 'em a good kick in the shins!

say:19:1029124017:1.text: That's right! That way, not just our parents but also knights like Mr. Valen...
say:19:1029124017:1.source_cn: 没错！这样的话，不管是爸爸妈妈，又或者是像维伦先生这样...

say:20:1029124018:1.text: You grown-ups would have to recognize our strength!
say:20:1029124018:1.source_cn: 你们这些大人，一定会发自内心地认可我们的实力！

say:21:1029124019:1.text: We wouldn't just be the "kids" you keep talking about, but heroes who could vanquish the Hypogeans!
say:21:1029124019:1.source_cn: 我们再也不是你们口中的“小孩子”，而是能战胜恶魔的勇士！

say:22:1029124020:1.text: Oh, I'm getting excited just thinking about it.
say:22:1029124020:1.source_cn: 哎呀，真是光靠想象都让人热血沸腾……

say:23:1029124021:1.text: So that's it. You've gone through so much, all for that. How to put it... it's just so childish.
say:23:1029124021:1.source_cn: 原来如此……你们折腾这么多，就是为了这个目的啊。该怎么...

say:25:1029124022:1.text: Hang on a minute! That's not what you said to me!
say:25:1029124022:1.source_cn: 等一下！什么“先召唤出恶魔，然后再狠狠打败他们”……这...

say:26:1029124023:1.text: Huh? What did we say back then?
say:26:1029124023:1.source_cn: 啊？我们……之前是怎么说的来着？

say:27:1029124024:1.text: You said that Hypogeans are super cool, and the Shadow Chasers were founded to worship them! You also said that you all hoped to become the kin of Hypogeans...
say:27:1029124024:1.source_cn: 你们之前说，恶魔超酷的，追影者的存在就是为了崇拜恶魔！...

say:28:1029124025:1.text: And once that happened, those Hypofiends would obey us and not hurt us anymore!
say:28:1029124025:1.source_cn: 一旦成为了恶魔的眷属，那些魔物作为恶魔的仆从，就会听从...

say:29:1029124026:1.text: Boss, that does sound like what our first goal was...
say:29:1029124026:1.source_cn: 老大，好像是有这么回事……这应该是我们最开始创建追影者...

say:30:1029124027:1.text: But we came up with this cool new story just last week!
say:30:1029124027:1.source_cn: 刚刚你说的那个”战胜恶魔“，似乎是上周才更新的……都还...

say:31:1029124028:1.text: Ahem! Anyway... in short, Dora, you know full well that any group can change as it grows.
say:31:1029124028:1.source_cn: 咳！总之……那个什么，朵拉，你也知道，任何组织都有可能...

say:32:1029124029:1.text: We need to embrace change in order to improve and look to the future! The Shadow Chasers now exist to vanquish Hypogeans!
say:32:1029124029:1.source_cn: 我们总要拥抱变化，才能变得更好。不要局限在过去，放眼看...

say:33:1029124030:1.text: Do you think I'm an idiot? If I'd known you were such an unreliable group, I'd never have wanted to join! I wouldn't have run off to the Sun Temple by myself—
say:33:1029124030:1.source_cn: 你当我是笨蛋啊！要是早知道你们是这么不靠谱的组织，我从...

say:35:1029124031:1.text: Let's stop arguing, kids. I have a proposal.
say:35:1029124031:1.source_cn: 各位，争论就到此为止吧。我有一个提议——

say:36:1029124032:1.text: I dunno why, but I've got a bad feeling about this...
say:36:1029124032:1.source_cn: 呃……不知道为什么，我突然有一种不太好的预感……

say:37:1029124033:1.text: Aren't those Hypofiends just the minions of Hypogeans? Since you can defeat them, surely the minions are a piece of cake, right?
say:37:1029124033:1.source_cn: 恶魔的仆从，不就是那些魔物嘛。你们既然连恶魔都能打败，...

say:38:1029124034:1.text: Why not let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> take you to get a good look at a real Hypofiend?
say:38:1029124034:1.male: Why not let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> take you to get a good look at a real Hypofiend?
say:38:1029124034:1.female: Why not let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> take you to get a good look at a real Hypofiend?

choice_prompt:39:1029124034.text: Why not let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> take you to get a good look at a real Hypofiend?
choice_prompt:39:1029124034.source_cn: 不如就由<style=stress><player_name></style>大人带领你们，去好好见识一下真正的魔物。
choice_prompt:39:1029124034.male: Why not let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> take you to get a good look at a real Hypofiend?
choice_prompt:39:1029124034.female: Why not let Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> take you to get a good look at a real Hypofiend?

say:40:1029124035:1.text: Boss! Can we really beat a Hypofiend?
say:40:1029124035:1.source_cn: 老大！这……我们真的打得过魔物吗？

say:41:1029124036:1.text: I don't know! I've never even seen a real Hypofiend before... But we've been studying them for so long now, surely it won't be a problem, right?
say:41:1029124036:1.source_cn: 我也不知道啊！我都没见过真正的魔物呢……但我们之前研究...

say:42:1029124037:1.text: Right! We've got a few tricks up our sleeves specifically for Hypogeans! This is a good chance to try 'em out on Hypofiends first.
say:42:1029124037:1.source_cn: 对哦，我们有专门的对付恶魔的特技！刚好可以在魔物身上试...

say:43:1029124038:1.text: Yeah! That's settled, then. Let's go battle a Hypofiend!
say:43:1029124038:1.source_cn: 没错！那就这么定了，我们愿意去和魔物战斗！

say:45:1029124039:1.text: Flaming idiots... I don't have to go, right?
say:45:1029124039:1.source_cn: 呵，愚蠢……你们很快就会后悔的。那个……我应该就不用去了吧？

say:46:1029124040:1.text: I've already seen the real thing. Close up!
say:46:1029124040:1.source_cn: 我已经充分，完整，零距离地见识过真正的魔物了！

say:47:1029124041:2.text: No. You need an extra lesson.
say:47:1029124041:2.source_cn: 不行，你的教训还需要强化一下。

say:48:1029124042:1.text: Haven't I learned it well enough already?
say:48:1029124042:1.source_cn: 我的教训明明已经很充分了！

say:49:1029124043:1.text: Sorry, no. I don't think it's really sunk in yet. Good luck!
say:49:1029124043:1.source_cn: 抱歉，不行哦，因为我觉得你还需要留下更深刻的记忆。祝你...

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你们为什么要成立追影者？
